UserWorkspaceSettings.title: UserWorkspaceSettings
UserWorkspaceSettings.description: Private workspace preferences and optional end-to-end encryption metadata owned by a single Google-authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

accentColor.description: Either 'default' or a 6-digit hex color code.

encryptionEnabled.description: Whether client-side AES-256-GCM end-to-end encryption is active for synced workspace content.

encryptionSalt.description: Non-secret random PBKDF2 salt (base64url) used to derive the user's AES-256-GCM key locally.

encryptionVerifier.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted verification sentinel used locally to verify the sync passphrase without ever storing the passphrase.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last settings update.

WorkspaceTabDoc.title: WorkspaceTabDoc
WorkspaceTabDoc.description: A top-level project workspace tab owned by a single user (supports plaintext or AES-256-GCM encrypted name).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

name.description: Display name of the project tab (plaintext up to 64 chars or AES-256-GCM ciphertext).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the tab was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last tab update.

TemplateCategoryDoc.title: TemplateCategoryDoc
TemplateCategoryDoc.description: A category inside a project tab owned by a single user (supports plaintext or AES-256-GCM encrypted name).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

name.description: Category display name (plaintext up to 64 chars or AES-256-GCM ciphertext).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the category was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last category update.

SnippetTemplateDoc.title: SnippetTemplateDoc
SnippetTemplateDoc.description: A reusable text/Markdown template owned by a single user (supports plaintext or AES-256-GCM encrypted title, content, and tags).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

categoryId.description: Single assigned category ID or empty string if unassigned.

title.description: Template title (plaintext up to 160 chars or AES-256-GCM ciphertext).

content.description: Template Markdown body (plaintext up to 50000 chars or AES-256-GCM ciphertext).

tags.description: Bounded list of up to 15 searchable tag strings (plaintext or AES-256-GCM ciphertext).

usageCount.description: Number of times this template has been copied.

lastCopiedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last copy or empty string.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the template was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last template update.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only private workspace settings and optional E2EE metadata for a Google-authenticated Notely user.

/users/{userId}/tabs/{tabId}.description: Project workspace tabs belonging exclusively to userId.

/users/{userId}/categories/{categoryId}.description: Template categories belonging exclusively to userId.

/users/{userId}/templates/{templateId}.description: Reusable text templates belonging exclusively to userId.
